displayName: Big Tech & Global Product SDE (Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Uber)
description: Global scale tier prioritizing algorithmic problem solving, clean system fundamentals, core data structures, and production-grade engineering agency.

coreFocus: Data structures and algorithms (arrays, trees, graphs, dynamic programming)
Computer science fundamentals (OS, networking, memory management, concurrency)
Clean, testable code with edge-case handling and optimal time/space complexity
High engineering agency and ownership of technical decisions
evaluationCriteria: Algorithmic correctness and time/space complexity optimization
Systems design principles (for experienced) and clean OOP/modular architecture (for freshers)
Structured problem decomposition under live pair programming conditions
Behavioral depth and post-mortem ownership
expectedArtifacts: Production-grade projects with automated unit/integration tests
High-performance implementations demonstrating concurrency or memory profiling
Clean GitHub repositories with meaningful commit history and clear README architecture diagrams

signals.text: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
LeetCode 2100+ contest rating (approx. 98th percentile of global contest participants). Highly regarded differentiator demonstrating rapid algorithmic formulation, but not a mandatory prerequisite.
Demonstrated scale metrics (e.g. throughput, query latency, multi-stage pipelines) in personal or internship projects.
Direct code contributions to recognized open-source libraries or foundational repositories.

displayName: Quant & Low-Latency Systems (Tower Research, Graviton, Jane Street, NK Securities)
description: Ultra-low-latency financial engineering evaluating mathematical rigour, probability, C++ template metaprogramming, Linux kernel bypass, and cache locality. Evaluated separately from distributed web systems.

coreFocus: Low-latency C++ (C++20, templates, move semantics, zero-allocation algorithms)
Computer architecture (CPU cache hierarchies, memory barriers, SIMD, lock-free queues)
Probability, combinatorics, stochastic processes, and linear algebra
Operating systems internals (Linux kernel bypass, epoll, network drivers, DPDK)
evaluationCriteria: Extreme algorithmic depth and execution speed
Deep hardware-level awareness (cache line alignment, branch prediction, assembly output)
Mathematical and statistical intuition under timed constraints
expectedArtifacts: Zero-allocation low-latency messaging queues or order-book simulators in modern C++
High-performance memory allocators or lock-free concurrent ring buffers
Competitive programming achievements (Codeforces Candidate Master / International Master / ACM-ICPC)

signals.text: Codeforces Candidate Master rating (1900+) or top 5% national competitive programming standing. Strong differentiator demonstrating rapid mathematical and algorithmic formulation under pressure.
signals.percentileContext: Top ~7% of active rated competitive programmers

signals.text: Deep proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20), pointer arithmetic, cache-friendly data structures, and multi-threaded synchronization.
Distributed web architectures (Kafka, Kubernetes, microservices) are NOT typically evaluated for core low-latency execution desks.

displayName: Indian High-Growth Product (Swiggy, Razorpay, CRED, Zomato, Zepto)
description: Fast-paced consumer and fintech scale-ups prioritizing product execution speed, full-stack resilience, pragmatic API design, and telemetry.

coreFocus: Modern full-stack or backend engineering (Node.js, Go, React, PostgreSQL, Redis)
End-to-end feature ownership and real user transaction handling
Pragmatic system architecture (caching, database indexing, background workers)
Observability, logging, and error tracking in production
evaluationCriteria: Feature delivery speed and pragmatic engineering trade-offs
Hands-on machine coding / modular component design in 90-120 minutes
Understanding of common failure modes in high-concurrency mobile/web APIs
expectedArtifacts: Deployed full-stack application with real authenticated users or webhooks
Relational database schema with indexes, transactions, and migration scripts
Redis caching or asynchronous background worker queue implementation

signals.text: Demonstrated capability to build and ship production features end-to-end using modern languages (Go, TypeScript, Python, or Java).
Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) including query planning and connection pooling.
Live deployed project link with verifiable database persistence and responsive interface.

displayName: Product MNC & Enterprise GCC (Adobe, Intuit, Salesforce, Oracle, Cisco, SAP)

coreFocus: Object-oriented design, design patterns, and clean code principles (SOLID)
Robust enterprise frameworks (Spring Boot, Java, Python, C#, React)
Comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, mocking, code coverage)
Database performance, query optimization, and enterprise API security
evaluationCriteria: Data structures and algorithmic fundamentals (medium difficulty)
Low-level object-oriented design and design pattern application
Disciplined engineering process awareness (CI/CD, code review, automated tests)
expectedArtifacts: Well-structured modular application with unit tests achieving >= 70% coverage
Documented RESTful API with authentication (OAuth2/JWT) and error contract
Clean Git branch workflows and pull request documentation

signals.text: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related discipline.
Solid comprehension of Object-Oriented Design principles, Design Patterns, and clean component layering.
Hands-on familiarity with unit testing frameworks (e.g. JUnit, Vitest, Jest) and automated build pipelines.
